checkpoint_selection: highest standalone mean official return, then completion, then earlier actual native frame
runtime_choice: CPU, four subprocess workers, one torch thread; successful deterministic execution; corrected CPU4 about1457 frames/s vs CUDA4 776 and CUDA8 766; eight CPU workers earlier only similar throughput
profile_caveat: single update, cold; actual longer training throughput must be reported; no guaranteed runtime or competence
normalization: reward only during training; no development updates
learning_rate: linear 1e-4 to zero over cumulative8M native frames; never restart at checkpoints
information: same local-v1 mask, ego and previous action; repeat4; no expert actions or truth labels
concurrency: one training child plus one queued checkpoint evaluator; validation contention included in observed training wall time
purpose: single-factor fresh training probe of conservative PPO optimization after the initial run regressed; seek a stronger standalone baseline
initialization: fresh seed0, not resume; same architecture and original global8M schedule; common numeric seed is not an independent replication
upstream_kl_rule: minibatch approximate reverse KL > 1.5*target stops remaining training for that rollout; not a hard divergence bound and may stop partway through an epoch
target_rationale: 0.02 is one declared development choice; threshold0.03 addresses previously increasing approximate KL; no small sweep or adaptive target changes in this block
causal_limit: one new fresh training run can inform engineering, not prove general optimizer causality or algorithm superiority
fairness: same native-frame and checkpoint-evaluation budgets, report actual optimizer work and compute; both original and corrective attempts count toward development cost
continuation_rule: stop at2M and review all four checkpoints; no automatic8M extension, search variants, or held-out evaluation
success_assessment: compare all scheduled standalone return/completion/off-road measurements and learning health with original; choose this trial checkpoint only by the original standalone rule
search_checkpoint_policy: existing six-condition search result remains tied to its original frozen1M checkpoint; do not swap identities or retrospectively rewrite it
